query: For my 49‑year‑old female patient: among female inpatients 44–54 with T2DM and heart failure, compare insulin vs oral agent prevalence (%) first 24h versus last 48h and report continued/initiated/discontinued counts.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.drug_type = 'insulin' AND h.intime BETWEEN a.admittime AND a.admittime + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN p.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.drug_type = 'oral agent' AND h.intime BETWEEN a.admittime + INTERVAL '24 hours' AND a.dischtime THEN p.subject_id END), 0) AS ratio FROM admissions a JOIN patients pt ON a.subject_id = pt.subject_id JOIN pharmacy p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN icustays h ON a.subject_id = h.subject_id WHERE pt.gender = 'F' AND pt.anchor_age BETWEEN 44 AND 54 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagnoses_icd d WHERE d.subject_id = a.subject_id AND d.icd_code IN ('250.0', '250.1')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procedures_icd pr WHERE pr.subject_id = a.subject_id AND pr.icd_code IN ('42842', '42843'));
